Examination reforms shape the future of a nation.

The appointment of Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani to lead the Exam Reforms Task Force reflects the growing importance of technology, governance, and institutional trust in education.

As exams impact millions of students every year, reforms must focus on:

Transparency and fairness

Technology-driven integrity

Faster and more reliable processes

A student-centric approach


When experienced leaders from technology, academia, and public institutions collaborate, they bring diverse perspectives that can strengthen systems for the long term.

Meaningful reforms are not just about solving today's challenges—they are about building a future where merit, trust, and opportunity go hand in hand.

Strong institutions create confident students. Confident students build stronger nations.

Follow mee - Sangeeta Kumari
